options.title: Laszlo Hanyecz paid bitcoin for two pizzas. What did they cost him? 🍕
options.first_line: Laszlo Hanyecz paid for {fact2} pizzas with bitcoin. So what did they really cost him?
options.first_frame: A small 2010 apartment at night: Laszlo, drawn, opens the door to a delivery driver holding two steaming Papa John's pizza boxes, a gold bitcoin coin spinning on his laptop screen behind him.

options.title: The most expensive pizzas ever bought? Laszlo Hanyecz's 🍕
options.first_line: Laszlo Hanyecz once bought the most expensive pizzas in history. He just didn't know it yet.
options.first_frame: Two Papa John's pizza boxes on a kitchen table under a lamp, a giant price tag with a question mark dangling over them, Laszlo staring at them.

options.title: 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas: Laszlo Hanyecz's deal 🍕
options.first_line: In 2010, Laszlo Hanyecz traded {fact1} bitcoin for {fact2} pizzas. How big was that bill later?
options.first_frame: A laptop with a pile of gold bitcoin coins pouring out of its screen into two Papa John's boxes held by Laszlo.

why: It names the man and the pizzas you can picture, asks what they really cost without giving the bitcoin count or the final figure away (B already calls them the most expensive pizzas ever, C puts 10,000 bitcoin in the title), and its first frame tells the story on mute.
